children: US handbag designer's fiscal Q2 revenue rose yr/yr, marking second consecutive quarter of growth
Company reiterated FY 2027 sales and operating margin guidance
Vera Bradley sees FY 2027 sales between $255 mln and $270 mln
Company expects FY 2027 non-GAAP operating loss improvement of at least 50% vs prior year loss of $21.7 mln
DIRECT SEGMENT GROWTH - Co said direct segment revenue rose 8% and comparable sales increased 9.2%, driven by improved ecommerce conversion and higher average transaction value
INDIRECT SEGMENT DECLINE - Co said indirect segment revenue fell 39% due to strategic shifts in marketplace strategy and reduced liquidation sales
TARIFF REFUNDS BOOST MARGIN - Co said gross margin rate increased due to $7.7 mln in tariff refunds received during the quarter
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "buy"
The average consensus recommendation for the apparel & accessories peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Vera Bradley Inc is $5.00, about 64.5% above its September 14 closing price of $3.04
